verdict.rationale: Goodwin has a dedicated Trademarks, Copyrights and Trade Secrets practice page covering trademark litigation, portfolio development and enforcement for named brands, so it is documented as its own practice. However, trademark clearance searching and registration/prosecution are only implied by 'portfolio development', not stated. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of trademark clearance/search work, explicit registration/prosecution services, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm handles trademark clearance, registration, and brand enforcement, documented as its own practice or team

citations.quote: In addition to trademark litigation, our practice also focuses on portfolio development and enforcement.
